environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 behind ALB, but the ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'app-query-string-inspection' at priority 200 that applies a regex_match on query string values against pattern `(?i)('|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|update\s|delete\s|drop\s|exec\s|xp_)` with action BLOCK and a custom response code 403, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in BLOCK mode with sensitivity level HIGH. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm rule group 2 and 3 are actively evaluating and blocking matching requests. Additionally, the ALB access logs show the WAF decision header x-amzn-waf-action is populated for all requests.

config.load_balancer: ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association, HTTPS:443 -> HTTP:8080
config.security_groups: sg-alb: inbound 443/tcp 0.0.0.0/0; sg-instance: inbound 8080/tcp from sg-alb
